roleWarning.fixed: All set, the bot can now give this role.
roleWarning.title: The bot can't give {roles}
roleWarning.moveUp: In Discord, open Server Settings > Roles and drag "{botRole}" above {roles}.
roleWarning.grantManageRoles: In Discord, open Server Settings > Roles and turn on the Manage Roles permission for "{botRole}".

statusPanel.placeholdersHint: Use {placeholders}; the bot swaps them for the live value on every update.
statusPanel.title: Title
statusPanel.descriptionPlaceholder: Use the buttons below to connect.
statusPanel.imageHint: Large image at the bottom of the Embed, below the fields. The thumbnail above sits in the top-right corner.
statusPanel.fieldsHint: Two inline fields in a row sit side by side; without inline, the field takes the whole row.
statusPanel.noFields: With no fields, the Embed has only the title, the description and the join button.
statusPanel.saveToPreview: Save the panel to see the live preview.

extras.linksHint: Links shown next to Join, on the same row: Discord, store, rules, website. Work in both formats.
extras.offlineHint: The panel changes on its own while the server is offline and goes back to normal when it returns. All optional.
extras.offlineBanner: Banner instead of the normal one (optional)
extras.restartsHint: The panel shows how long until the next one. In your own layout and in the embed, use {placeholders}.
extras.timezoneHint: Used for restart times and for when the daily player peak resets.

templates.pick: Start from a template (replaces the current layout):
templates.compactHint: Name, status and players in one line, with the banner beside them.
templates.bannerHint: Featured banner, status and the connect address to copy.
templates.completeHint: Everything: capacity, next restart, daily peak and last update.
templates.connectHint: Use the buttons below to join.

composer.fieldHint: Dynamic field; the bot fills in the value.
composer.empty: Use the bar above to add blocks.
composer.help: Click a block to edit it, drag it by the handle (⠿) to reorder.
composer.helpFields: In fields you only change the label; the bot fills in the value when posting.
composer.textPlaceholder: Write here… (bold, italic, emojis and more in the bar above)

button.counterHint: Participant counter (filled in by the bot)

section.empty: Add text or a field (max 3) next to the image.

gallery.max: Up to {max} images in the gallery.
